purpose: Crypto networks, tokens, custody, markets, governance, and legal protections in named jurisdictions.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Date legal classifications and product terms; separate protocol claims from intermediary promises and avoid individualized financial advice.
